title: Statement Coverage Points in Northgate Card Late Fee Courtesy
content:
**Rule.** In the courtesy reversal of a late fee on a **Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.)** account, the coverage points follow what the payments recorded against the fee statement covered: payments reaching its whole new balance grant 8 points; payments reaching its minimum payment due but not its new balance grant 4 points; anything less grants none.

**Fee statement and its payments.** The fee statement is the statement the courtesy late fee — the most recent late fee on the account — was recorded for, and the payments recorded against it are the payment entries that carry its closing date. The new balance and the minimum payment due are the figures printed on that statement.

**Hypothetical fee statement** with a new balance of 860.00 and a minimum payment due of 40.00:

| Payments recorded against it | Coverage points |
|---|---|
| 860.00 or more | 8 |
| 40.00 up to 859.99 | 4 |
| below 40.00, or none | none |
